author: Ryan Daws
description:
Visa has updated its open-source vulnerability tool, VVAH, to add remediation, validation, and model choice for security teams. The company has also expanded its Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA) Cybersecurity Advisory Practice with new services intended to help clients assess risk, prioritise remediation efforts, and build resilience as threats evolve. title: Visa updates open-source VVAH tool with vulnerability remediation
